Headline: No trains between Kimball and Southport
ShortDescription: Brown Line service has been temporarily suspended between Kimball and Southport due to fire department activity.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Brown Line service has been temporarily suspended between Kimball and Southport due to fire department activity.

As a result, trains are operating only between The Loop and Belmont at this time.

Shuttle buses have been requested from Kimball to Southport, in both directions to provide connecting service through the affected area. 

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes, or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:
#81 Lawrence
#80 Irving Park
#152 Addison

See station personnel for further assistance, and pay attention to announcements on trains and at stations for service information.

We are working to restore service as quickly as possible. Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Linen-bound Purple Line Delays
ShortDescription: Linden-bound Purple Line trains are running w/residual delays following an earlier delay near Fullerton. Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Linden-bound Purple Line trains are running w/residual delays following an earlier delay near Fullerton.

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.
